name: Residente Temporal Trabajador (permiso de trabajo)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a confirmed position with a Costa Rican legal entity (as an employee) or a qualifying basis for self-employment, per the migratory categories for company executives, technical staff, scientists/professionals/specialised technicians, or other specific occupations under Article 79.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a confirmed qualifying position or self-employment basis.

sources.title: Defensoría de los Habitantes de la República (dhr.go.cr) -- Ley General de Migración y Extranjería No. 8764, Título VI, Article 79 (categories including company executives/technical staff, scientists/professionals, credentialed athletes, press correspondents)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. Article 79 lists several distinct named occupational subcategories (executives/technical staff of companies, scientists/professionals/specialised technicians, credentialed athletes, press correspondents, religious personnel, transborder workers, project-specific workers) rather than one generic 'work permit' -- collapsed here into a single route with a general job-offer requirement rather than building out each named occupational subcategory separately, since their individual specific criteria were not itemised in the source text fetched.
